cues: Multiply out the first few powers of a plus b, and watch.
The power of a falls from n to zero.
The power of b rises from zero to n.
And the coefficients, one two one, one three three one, one four six four one, are the rows of Pascal's triangle.
text: Multiply out the first few powers of a plus b, and watch. The power of a falls from n to zero. The power of b rises from zero to n. They always add to n. And the coefficients, one two one, one three three one, one four six four one, are the rows of Pascal's triangle.
